hint: Drag the center or radius · Escape to cancel
centerHelp: Drag to move the effect center.
radiusHelp: Drag to adjust how far the effect reaches.
innerRadiusHelp: Drag to resize the protected area.
featherHelp: Drag to adjust the transition between the sharp and blurred areas.
keyboardHelp: Arrow keys: 1 px · Shift: 10 px · Escape: cancel.
